programs.title: Love It or List It Vancouver
programs.desc: A family with two adult children need a bigger home.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: Scott & Bryan work on adding value to the property, while the teams take on two small but critical spaces, the front entry and main bathroom. These high-traffic areas demand clever functionality and must make a stellar first impression. It's a designer showdown as Chalon & Tatianna both swing for the fences, Marcy finds herself stretched beyond her comfort zone, and Taylor's indecision explodes into a full-blown wallpaper fiasco!

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Matt and Sam are at their wit's end. The daily grind of raising two young kids while juggling careers and Matt's busy marathon schedule has worn them down. They have no time to keep their home organized and clutter has consumed their lives, taking a toll on their relationship. Kortney and Kenny help them through the emotional journey of letting go, so they can get their home organized, functional, and a place to love again.

programs.title: Love It or List It UK
programs.desc: Kirstie and Phil are in Chippenham to help Tim and Sonia decide whether to stay put or sell their home; the couple moved into Tim's childhood home eight years ago to care for his elderly mother and Sonia became her primary carer before she passed.

programs.title: Love It or List It UK
programs.desc: Visiting Swansea to help Sarah and Caradog, who moved into their four-bedroom home shortly before their third child arrived in 2008 and have struggled for space ever since.

programs.title: Love It or List It UK
programs.desc: Kirstie and Phil visit Caterham in Surrey to help Ruth and Ken settle their debate over their three-storey town house; Ruth is tired of the kitchen and lounge being on separate floors, but Ken's worked hard transforming their home and wants to stay.
